sql: SELECT current_setting('server_version') AS version, current_setting('server_version_num') AS version_num, pg_is_in_recovery() AS in_recovery

SELECT attrelid::regclass::text AS rel, attname, has_column_privilege('agent_reader', attrelid, attnum, 'SELECT') AS can_select FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid IN ('analytics.orders'::regclass, 'analytics.customer'::regclass, 'analytics.big_fact'::regclass, 'analytics.empty_vis'::regclass) AND attnum > 0 AND NOT attisdropped ORDER BY 1, attnum
SELECT o.id, o.region, o.amount FROM analytics.orders o WHERE o.region = 'eu' ORDER BY o.id
SELECT * FROM analytics.orders o WHERE o.region = 'eu' ORDER BY o.id
SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.orders o WHERE o.region = 'eu'
SELECT * FROM analytics.orders JOIN analytics.customer USING (id) WHERE orders.region = 'eu' ORDER BY orders.id
SELECT c.id, c.name FROM analytics.customer c ORDER BY c.id
SELECT jt.id FROM json_table('[{"id": 1}]', '$[*]' COLUMNS (id int PATH '$.id')) AS jt
SELECT * FROM analytics.big_fact b WHERE true
SELECT * FROM (SELECT b.id, b.ts FROM analytics.big_fact b) s
SELECT b.id, b.ts FROM analytics.big_fact b
